tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: App frame, title bar and the gutters between panels. True neutral: never tinted.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Panel backgrounds: media bin, inspector, timeline header, AI Studio.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised elements: inputs, cards, menus, popovers, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed rows, toolbar button hover. Not a selection color (use marigold-subtle).

tokens.name: surface-preview
tokens.usage: Surround behind the video preview. Strictly neutral so footage color is judged correctly; nothing else sits on it except overlays.

tokens.name: timeline-lane
tokens.usage: Track lane background in the timeline.

tokens.name: timeline-lane-alt
tokens.usage: Alternate track lanes, and the gap fill shown while a ripple edit is previewed.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between panel regions and list rows.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Outlines of cards, menus, popovers and media tiles.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox, switch and slider-track outlines. Meets 3:1 on surface-1, surface-2 and timeline-lane in both themes.

tokens.name: scrollbar-thumb
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumb at rest. The track stays transparent, so the thumb sits on whatever surface scrolls.

tokens.name: scrollbar-thumb-hover
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumb under the pointer or while dragged.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body copy, values and clip labels on surface-0 to surface-3 and on every clip-*-body.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Control labels and secondary metadata on surface-0 to surface-3.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Hints, placeholders, ruler ticks and timecode units on surface-0 to surface-3 (at least 4.5:1).

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only; exempt from contrast rules. Never for information the user needs.

tokens.name: marigold
tokens.usage: The Cutweave thread: primary buttons, the playhead, selection edges and the active tool. Means 'here' and 'this will act'. Never decorative.

tokens.name: marigold-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of primary (marigold) buttons; keep on-marigold text.

tokens.name: on-marigold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on marigold fills (primary buttons, playhead flag).

tokens.name: marigold-text
tokens.usage: Marigold as text or icon on surface-1 and surface-2: active tab label, links, active tool icon.

tokens.name: marigold-subtle
tokens.usage: Selected rows, selected media tiles and active toggles, behind text-primary.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 1px offset. At least 3:1 on every surface and on timeline-lane.

tokens.name: playhead
tokens.usage: Playhead line and flag in the timeline and the ruler.

tokens.name: agent
tokens.usage: AI and agent presence: AI badges, agent proposal outlines, copilot accents, generated-media provenance. Never used for primary actions.

tokens.name: agent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of agent buttons (Accept proposal); keep on-agent text.

tokens.name: on-agent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on agent fills (agent badge, Accept-proposal button).

tokens.name: agent-text
tokens.usage: Agent or AI wording as text on surface-1 and surface-2 (for example 'Proposed by agent').

tokens.name: agent-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill behind pending agent proposals (ghost clips, proposal bar); always paired with a dashed agent outline.

tokens.name: clip-media
tokens.usage: Video, image and sticker clips: header strip, border and track icon. At least 3:1 on timeline-lane.

tokens.name: clip-media-body
tokens.usage: Body of video, image and sticker clips behind thumbnails and the label (text-primary).

tokens.name: clip-audio
tokens.usage: Audio clips: header strip, border, waveform stroke.

tokens.name: clip-audio-body
tokens.usage: Body of audio clips behind the waveform and the label.

tokens.name: clip-graphics
tokens.usage: Text, title, composition and generator clips: header strip, border.

tokens.name: clip-graphics-body
tokens.usage: Body of text, composition and generator clips.

tokens.name: clip-captions
tokens.usage: Caption blocks on caption tracks: header strip, border, transcript word highlight.

tokens.name: clip-captions-body
tokens.usage: Body of caption blocks.

tokens.name: clip-effects
tokens.usage: Effect, filter and adjustment clips: header strip, border, effect badge on clips.

tokens.name: clip-effects-body
tokens.usage: Body of effect, filter and adjustment clips.

tokens.name: label-red

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on surface-1 and surface-2 (export finished, model connected). Always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on surface-1 and surface-2 (missing media, budget near limit). Always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions: text and icons on surface-1 and surface-2, destructive button fill.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of destructive buttons; keep on-danger text.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger fills (Delete originals button).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs and the command palette.

tokens.name: overlay-guide
tokens.usage: Safe-area guides, grids and crop rectangles drawn over video; always with a 1px overlay-guide-shadow outline so they read on any footage.

tokens.name: overlay-guide-shadow
tokens.usage: Outline paired with overlay-guide and transform handles over video.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Onboarding, empty project screen, website heroes. Never inside the editor chrome.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Welcome screen headings, template gallery titles.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Dialog titles and AI Studio result headers.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Panel titles and inspector section headings.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Captions follow the clip they were transcribed from.
styles.usage: Default UI text: menus, descriptions, transcript panel, copilot messages.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text and button labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Clip labels, media tile metadata, badges.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Set in uppercase. Inspector group eyebrows and asset browser section labels only.

styles.name: timecode-lg
styles.usage: Transport timecode above the timeline. Tabular by design.

styles.name: timecode
styles.usage: In/out points, clip durations in tooltips, marker lists.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Values in number scrubbers, sliders, export settings and cost estimates.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a clip's header strip and its body; icon-to-badge nudges.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside segmented controls and between toolbar icon buttons.

tokens.name: space-1-5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons and tabs.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inner padding of inputs, chips and clip labels; gap between inspector rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel side padding; gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and popover padding; gap between inspector sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; gap between asset browser groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty-state spacing and onboarding layouts.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Welcome screen and template gallery outer margins.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Markers, keyframe hit areas, tiny badges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, timeline clips, chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, cards, inspector sections.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, media tiles, AI Studio result cards.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, switches, cost and status chips, the playhead flag.

shadow.note: Borders and surface steps carry hierarchy; shadows only lift things that float above the workspace.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips, the command palette.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the export sheet.

tokens.name: shadow-drag
tokens.usage: A clip or tile while it is being dragged.

size.note: Fixed component dimensions for a dense editor. Hit areas never go below hit-min.

tokens.name: hit-min
tokens.usage: Minimum pointer target (WCAG 2.2 target size). Small icons get an invisible hit area of this size.

tokens.name: scrollbar
tokens.usage: Scrollbar gutter thickness. The thumb is inset by border-thick on each side, so it draws 6px wide with a full radius.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of inspector inputs, number scrubbers, chips, segmented controls.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Height of default buttons, selects, search fields.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Height of primary buttons in dialogs and AI Studio.

tokens.name: toolbar
tokens.usage: Height of the main toolbar (the top bar, which is also the window's title bar: the OS window-controls overlay is exactly this tall) and the transport bar.

tokens.name: panel-header
tokens.usage: Height of panel title bars and tab strips.

tokens.name: track-sm
tokens.usage: Collapsed track height (labels only).

tokens.name: track-md
tokens.usage: Default track height (label plus thumbnails or waveform).

tokens.name: track-lg
tokens.usage: Expanded track height for keyframe lanes and detailed waveforms.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside clips, chips and dense lists.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size in panels, menus and inspector.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Toolbar and transport icons.

tokens.name: clip-strip
tokens.usage: Height of the colored header strip on timeline clips.

tokens.name: layer-width-sm
tokens.usage: Menus, context menus and cost popovers.

tokens.name: layer-width-md
tokens.usage: Dialogs such as Export and Settings.

tokens.name: layer-width-lg
tokens.usage: Command palette and the AI Studio result viewer.

tokens.name: z-playhead
tokens.usage: Playhead above clips and keyframes.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Preview overlays: transform handles, safe areas, crop box.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the command palette.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts and job notifications.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips, always on top.

duration.note: Nothing in the timeline or preview animates while playback runs.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed states, toggles.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, panel tab switches.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Dialogs, toasts, agent proposal reveal.

tokens.name: easing-standard
tokens.usage: Default for state changes and layout shifts.

tokens.name: easing-enter
tokens.usage: Elements appearing: menus, toasts, dialogs.

tokens.name: easing-exit
tokens.usage: Elements leaving.

tokens.name: border-thin
tokens.usage: Hairlines, control outlines, clip borders.

tokens.name: border-thick
tokens.usage: Selection outlines, focus ring, active tab underline, slider thumb ring.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled clips and tracks (content still visible but inactive). Labels use text-disabled instead.

density.note: Standard is the size and spacing tokens above, with data-density="compact" on the root. A set here makes some of them larger under data-density="<id>". It never changes a color, a type style, an icon size or a radius, so every contrast pair holds in every density. Components read the same tokens in every density and never test the attribute.

sets.name: Comfortable
sets.usage: Settings > Appearance > Density. Taller controls, rows, bars and tracks with more room around them, for touch screens, high-resolution displays and long sessions. Text and icons keep their size.

tokens.name: hit-min
tokens.usage: Minimum pointer target in Comfortable: a small icon's hit area grows with the controls.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Inspector inputs, number scrubbers, chips and segmented controls in Comfortable.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons, selects and search fields in Comfortable; also the timeline ruler.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary buttons in dialogs and AI Studio in Comfortable.

tokens.name: toolbar
tokens.usage: The top bar (the window's title bar) in Comfortable; the OS window-controls overlay follows it.

tokens.name: panel-header
tokens.usage: Panel title bars and tab strips in Comfortable.

tokens.name: track-sm
tokens.usage: Collapsed track height in Comfortable.

tokens.name: track-md
tokens.usage: Default track height in Comfortable. A track with a height of its own keeps it.

tokens.name: track-lg
tokens.usage: Expanded track height in Comfortable.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inner padding of inputs, chips and clip labels, and the gap between inspector rows, in Comfortable.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel side padding and the gap between form fields in Comfortable.

tokens.name: space-4
